The '''stardust pass''' was an area of space in the [[Kantel system]] where, once a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyed Kant]] passed through the system's belts of stellar debris. The passage subjected Tyed Kant to intense [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]] showers which sparked beautiful but deadly [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] fires. Due to the danger, the residents of Tyed Kant sheltered behind the protective shields of their floating ranches and enjoyed a roughly thirty-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] holiday.
